hints.title: A dot is a choice
hints.body: A normal pattern character selects one child edge in a prefix tree. A dot allows every child edge, so the search may branch.

hints.title: Store words in a trie
hints.body: Nodes need a character-to-child map and a flag for the end of a stored word. Added words share their common prefixes.

hints.title: The pattern must be exhausted
hints.body: A branch succeeds only when every pattern character has been consumed and the current node is terminal. Reaching a terminal node early would accept a word that is too short.
